features.title: Login page

Sign up is an embedded link to the sign-up page. Existing users can log in with valid credentials and are redirected to a placeholder main app page. Incorrect credentials display an error message.

Enter incorrect credentials and verify an error message is displayed without redirecting.
Verify the page remains responsive at supported viewport sizes.

features.title: OTP verification page
features.user_visible_behavior: After submitting an email on the sign-up page, the user sees a success message confirming that an OTP has been sent and is redirected to the OTP verification page. The page displays an OTP input field and a Continue button. Invalid or expired OTPs display an error message below the input field. Successful verification redirects the user to the account creation page without displaying an error message.
